## Description

An `ADVANCED_FACE` is emitted with an empty bounds list — no `FACE_OUTER_BOUND` and no `FACE_BOUND`. Either the writer dropped the loop or the face represents a complete surface (sphere/torus) where natural bounds are implied.

## Reproducer recipe

`#10=ADVANCED_FACE('',(),#20,.T.);` whose `face_geometry #20` is a `SPHERICAL_SURFACE` or `TOROIDAL_SURFACE`.

## Expected kernel behavior

when the surface is closed/periodic in U and V, insert natural bounds. Otherwise, drop the face with a diagnostic — never construct a face with an empty wire set.
